# Events & Launches Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard gives Template event and field marketing leaders a view of upcoming activations, registration health, and production readiness. It supports event producers, field marketers, and launch owners in catching under-registered events, budget overruns, and vendor risk.

## Key Metrics
- Upcoming Events: 6
- Total Registered: 758
- Spend vs Budget: 48%
- Tasks Due This Week: 14
- Leads Generated: 500

## Insights
- Flagship summit is pacing behind on registration — push demand gen support
- Webinar-series conversion holds at 22%; webinar #2 is on track
- Roadshow spend is concentrated in NCR — consider reallocating to secondary cities
